entries: Owner instruction 'Proceed with stage 3'. Stage tool reads nonlinear-orbit preparations with the orbit linearised at published values and can draw nulls from a released noise chain. tools/joint_noise_nonlinear_check.py re-fits the orbit nonlinearly: 42 simulated vectors, largest statistic change 0.11 (tolerance 0.5). 5 unit tests.
Decision statistic is the linearised one; the nonlinear fit is a declared validity check.

189-member noise grid and seven generators (one from the released NANOGrav chain) declared before the run. Joint statistic 18.419 at 37.57 d (18.240 at 37.48 d) against threshold 23.001; fixed-noise 26.871 against 23.998. Nonlinear-orbit check 18.446, CONSISTENT. 17-53 of 1024 validation nulls per generator reach the observed value. Signal-hypothesis noise on a grid edge.
run01 consumed; do not rerun. Crossing does not survive; grade unchanged (INCONCLUSIVE_NOISE_SENSITIVE). Independent telescope data still needed.
